authors: Julien Siems, Timur Carstensen, Arber Zela, Frank Hutter, Massimiliano Pontil, Riccardo Grazzi
title: DeltaProduct: Improving State-Tracking in Linear RNNs via Householder Products
relevance: The R>1 Householder-product mechanism. Its Theorem 1 gives the three routes for S_n. Evaluates S3/S4/A5/S5 at 1 layer varying n_h, and layers at n_h=1. Gate is a Mamba2 per-head SCALAR.

authors: Riccardo Grazzi, Julien Siems, Arber Zela, Jorg K.H. Franke, Frank Hutter, Massimiliano Pontil
title: Unlocking State-Tracking in Linear RNNs Through Negative Eigenvalues
relevance: Source of allow_neg_eigval. Thm 1: parity needs a non-nonnegative eigenvalue. Thm 3: FSA whose transition monoid is a group, 1 layer, k-1 Householders. Prop 1.1: spectral norm <= 1.

authors: Kimi Team (Yu Zhang, Zongyu Lin, Xingcheng Yao, Jiaxi Hu, Fanqing Meng, ... Yulun Du)
title: Kimi Linear: An Expressive, Efficient Attention Architecture
relevance: Defines KDA. Recurrence S_t = (I - beta k k^T) Diag(alpha_t) S_{t-1} + beta k v^T. head dim d_k = d_v = 128 in all experiments. NO gate-granularity ablation anywhere.

authors: Songlin Yang, Jan Kautz, Ali Hatamizadeh
title: Gated Delta Networks: Improving Mamba2 with Delta Rule
relevance: GDN, the per-HEAD scalar-gate comparator. Eq 8 alpha_t is scalar per head; paper itself notes GLA-like diagonal gating is left to future work.

authors: David A. Mix Barrington
title: Bounded-width polynomial-size branching programs recognize exactly those languages in NC^1
venue: J. Computer and System Sciences 38(1):150-164 (STOC 1986 special issue)
relevance: The NC1-completeness half: the word problem of any finite NON-SOLVABLE group is NC1-complete. S5/width-5 is the construction, not the title.

authors: David A. Mix Barrington, Denis Therien
title: Finite monoids and the fine structure of NC^1
relevance: The ACC0 half: solvable monoids characterize ACC0. Needed for "solvable groups' word problems are easy". Primary text paywalled; dichotomy verified via Bartholdi et al. CCC 2020 restatement.

authors: Bingbin Liu, Jordan T. Ash, Surbhi Goel, Akshay Krishnamurthy, Cyril Zhang
title: Transformers Learn Shortcuts to Automata
relevance: The depth/solvability split for sequence models. Thm 2: solvable semiautomata at depth independent of T. Thm 4: non-solvable impossible at T-independent depth unless TC0 = NC1.

authors: William Merrill, Jackson Petty, Ashish Sabharwal
title: The Illusion of State in State-Space Models
relevance: SSMs are in L-uniform TC0; cannot solve S5 unless TC0 = NC1. Source of the S3/S4/A5/S5 task code DeltaProduct uses. CAVEAT: empirically their solvable A4xZ5 ALSO needed growing depth.

authors: William Merrill, Ashish Sabharwal
title: The Parallelism Tradeoff: Limitations of Log-Precision Transformers
relevance: Log-precision transformers are in logspace-uniform TC0. The upper bound that makes S5 (NC1-complete) out of reach.

authors: Yash Sarrof, Yana Veitsman, Michael Hahn
title: The Expressive Capacity of State Space Models: A Formal Language Perspective
relevance: Thm 2: no SSM with a NONNEGATIVE gate recognizes parity. The result Grazzi et al. generalize. NB their condition is gate nonnegativity, not "eigenvalues in [0,1]" (that framing is Grazzi et al.'s).

authors: Bo Peng et al. (RWKV team)
title: RWKV-7 "Goose" with Expressive Dynamic State Evolution
relevance: CRITICAL PRIOR ART: RWKV-7 already pairs a per-channel vector decay diag(w_t) with a Householder-like rank-1 term, at R=1. So per-channel-gate + Householder is not novel; only R>1 is.

authors: Xiao Li, Chengruidong Zhang, Hao Luo, Xi Lin, Zekun Wang, Zihan Qiu, Yunfei Mao, Langshi Chen, Man Yuan, Minmin Sun, Huiqiang Jiang, Siqi Zhang, Rui Men, Wei Hu, Gong Cheng, Bo Zheng, Dayiheng Liu, Jingren Zhou
title: Erase-then-Delta Attention: Decoupling Erase and Write Addresses in Delta-Rule Linear Attention
relevance: CRITICAL PRIOR ART: trains per-channel Diag(alpha_t) with TWO rank-1 factors per token at 2.5B dense / 25B-A2.8B MoE, via the same interleave-into-2T + KDA WY-kernel trick. Second factor is an asymmetric erase (v=0), fixed R=2.

authors: Ali Hatamizadeh, Yejin Choi, Jan Kautz
title: Gated DeltaNet-2: Decoupling Erase and Write in Linear Attention
relevance: Channel-wise erase+write gates at R=1. Table 5 is a real channel-vs-scalar gate ablation at 1.3B/100B: scalarizing either gate hurts. Also reports beta in [0,2] gives no consistent gain at 1.3B.

authors: Pingwei Sun, Yuxuan Hu, Jianchao Tan, Xue Wang, Jiaqi Zhang, Yifan Lu, Yerui Sun, Yuchen Xie, Xunliang Cai
title: FG^2-GDN: Enhancing Long-Context Gated Delta Networks with Doubly Fine-Grained Control
relevance: Channel-wise decay AND channel-wise beta, R=1. Their Table 1 at 340M/15B has KDA (43.14) BELOW GDN (43.51) - independent published support that per-channel > per-head is scale-dependent.

authors: Songlin Yang, Bailin Wang, Yikang Shen, Rameswar Panda, Yoon Kim
title: Gated Linear Attention Transformers with Hardware-Efficient Training
relevance: The one clean gate-granularity ablation: at 340M/7B, per-channel vector gate 14.77 ppl vs data-dependent scalar 15.56. LM perplexity only; GLA runs NO state-tracking task.

authors: Songlin Yang, Bailin Wang, Yu Zhang, Yikang Shen, Yoon Kim
title: Parallelizing Linear Transformers with the Delta Rule over Sequence Length
relevance: DeltaNet's chunkwise/WY algorithm; the memory-efficient Householder-product representation the kernel work builds on. Venue via Semantic Scholar only.

authors: Imanol Schlag, Kazuki Irie, Jurgen Schmidhuber
title: Linear Transformers Are Secretly Fast Weight Programmers
relevance: Origin of the delta rule in linear attention.

authors: Gregoire Deletang, Anian Ruoss, Jordi Grau-Moya, Tim Genewein, Li Kevin Wenliang, Elliot Catt, Chris Cundy, Marcus Hutter, Shane Legg, Joel Veness, Pedro A. Ortega
title: Neural Networks and the Chomsky Hierarchy
relevance: Precedent for synthetic formal-language probes as a primary endpoint. NB contains NO group word problem and no S5 - do not cite it for S5.

authors: Simran Arora, Sabri Eyuboglu, Aman Timalsina, Isys Johnson, Michael Poli, James Zou, Atri Rudra, Christopher Re
title: Zoology: Measuring and Improving Recall in Efficient Language Models
relevance: Introduces MQAR. Precedent for a synthetic diagnostic that is validated against LM-scale runs.

authors: Simran Arora, Sabri Eyuboglu, Michael Zhang, Aman Timalsina, Silas Alberti, James Zou, Atri Rudra, Christopher Re
title: Simple linear attention language models balance the recall-throughput tradeoff
relevance: Diagnostic-first methodology: MQAR sweep precedes and motivates the architecture, then LM at 360M/1.3B. arXiv version adds a 9th author, Dylan Zinsley.

authors: William Merrill, Yanhong Li, Tyler Romero, ... Noah A. Smith, Hannaneh Hajishirzi, Ashish Sabharwal
title: Olmo Hybrid (synthetic state-tracking probes + 7B GDN-hybrid LM)
relevance: Closest methodological precedent: few-million-param probes (4 layers, d_model 256, head dim 64) with multi-seed sweeps, paired with a 7B LM. Legitimizes the probe scale. Exact title not independently re-verified.

authors: Jiaxi Hu, Yongqi Pan, Jusen Du, Disen Lan, Xiaqiang Tang, Qingsong Wen, Yuxuan Liang, Weigao Sun
title: Comba: Improving Bilinear RNNs with Closed-loop Control
relevance: Adjacent structured-transition variant (SPLR). NB Kimi Linear's bib carries the stale v1 title "Nonlinear"; current title is "Bilinear".

authors: An Yang et al. (Qwen Team)
title: Qwen3 Technical Report
relevance: Umbrella citation for Qwen3. NB there is NO Qwen3-Next or Qwen3.5 paper on arXiv; cite the model card as @misc for the GDN-3:1-hybrid architecture claim.
